request: Pull World Bank military expenditure (% of GDP) indicator MS.MIL.XPND.GD.ZS for all countries, 2010-2024. Enrich each row with a spend_band (very_low / low / moderate / elevated / high) and years_since_observation for recency. Publish to 'Prep Agent / 19 - World Bank Military Expenditure' on Tableau Server for defense-economics + arms-industry analysts.

sources.name: World Bank Military Expenditure
sources.description: World Bank Open Data indicator MS.MIL.XPND.GD.ZS (military expenditure as % of GDP). Response is a 2-element JSON envelope: [ {page, pages, per_page, total, lastupdated}, [ {indicator:{id,value}, country:{id,value}, countryiso3code, date, value, unit, obs_status, decimal}, ... ] ]. Use json_records_path='1' to index into the second element (the data array). Page-paginated (~4k rows for 2010:2024 global).

args.name: MilExp Trend
args.features_description: Row-level World Bank observation with calendar features derived from `date` (year, month, quarter, day_of_week, iso_week). Note: `date` is a year-only string cast to ISO year for feature purposes.
args.stats_description: Long-form military-spend statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month). Includes 365-day rolling counts, z-score anomalies. Use to identify countries with sudden spend-band transitions.

outputs.name: WB Military Expenditure Detail
outputs.description: Row-level World Bank military-expenditure observations (MS.MIL.XPND.GD.ZS, % of GDP), 2010-2024, all countries + aggregates. Fields: countryiso3code, country_name, country_id, indicator_id/name, date (year), value (% of GDP), unit, obs_status, decimal, spend_band (very_low<1% / low<2% / moderate<3.5% / elevated<5% / high>=5%). Plus calendar features. Source: api.worldbank.org indicator API. Refresh: daily.

outputs.name: WB Military Expenditure Stats
outputs.description: Long-form military-expenditure trend statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over country_name and spend_band). Includes 365-day rolling counts, z-score anomalies, lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Joinable from Tableau on (dimension, value, year, month). Use to identify countries transitioning across spend bands.
